plan: [This is a sealed-bid second-price auction (Vickrey) with independent private values. Bidding my true value is a dominant strategy and maximizes expected surplus regardless of others. There is no benefit to shading or overbidding; if I win I pay the second-highest bid. No past rounds to learn from. Use the $0.1 increment and submit my value as the bid.]

[Because this is a second-price sealed-bid auction with independent private values, truthful bidding is a dominant strategy. There is no prior history to exploit. Bidding my private value ($36) maximizes expected profit: I win when competitors' highest bid is below 36 and then pay the second-highest bid.]

[In a sealed-bid second-price auction, bidding your true private value is a dominant strategy. Rational opponents will also bid their values, so truthful bidding maximizes expected surplus: you win when others' highest bid is below your value and pay the second-highest. Underbidding risks losing positive surplus; overbidding risks paying more than value. Tie probability is negligible. Therefore bid your value to maximize long-run profit.]
